extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome Web Store and browser toolbar.

extDescription.message: Precise watermarks by domain, URL, IP, or Cookie. Prevents mistakes on prod. Includes smart contrast color, immersive border, activity fade.
extDescription.description: Extension short description in the Chrome Web Store.

extDefaultTitle.description: Tooltip when hovering the toolbar icon.

subtitle.message: Precise environment badges by domain, URL, Cookie, or IP

langLabel.description: Label for the language picker in the options page.

langAuto.description: Language picker option that follows the browser UI language.

emptyListHint.message: Click the + button to create your first config

shortLabelHint.message: Shows on the toolbar icon (max 4 chars)

rulesHint.message: Any matching rule triggers; the most specific rule wins.

rulePlaceholderCookie.message: e.g. env=prod  or  env~=stage  or  just a name

ruleHintCookie.message: Syntax: name=value equals; name~=fragment contains; just name checks existence.

textHint.message: Line breaks supported; variables like {user}/{date} coming later.

smartColorHint.message: Auto-invert against page background. Color picker is replaced by tone.

borderHint.message: A thick inset border around the viewport, spot at a glance. Great for production.

mouseFadeHint.message: Temporarily hide the watermark while you inspect UI; restore after idle.

emptyDesc.message: Click the + button on the top left to create your first watermark config

toastImported.description: Placeholder {n} is replaced with the number of imported configs.

toastInvalidUrl.message: Invalid URL: include http:// or https://

toastStorageError.description: Placeholder {msg} is replaced with the error message from chrome.storage.

toastRuleValueNoMask.message: This rule type does not accept a mask; use IP CIDR instead

testUnsafeRegex.message: Blocked: pattern likely catastrophic, would freeze pages

testRegexTooLong.description: Placeholder {max} is replaced with the regex length limit.

toastFeatureLocked.message: This feature is not available in the current version

toastModalMissing.message: UI failed to load; please reload the extension

confirmImport.message: Import will append to existing configs. Continue?

confirmDeleteRule.message: Are you sure you want to delete this rule?

confirmDeleteConfig.message: Are you sure you want to delete this config? This cannot be undone.

helpStep1.message: Click the + button in the top-left to create a new config

helpStep2.message: Open the Match Rules tab and set trigger conditions

helpStep3.message: Open the Style tab to tune watermark text, color, and opacity

helpTip1.message: A config can hold multiple rules; any match triggers it

helpTip2.message: When multiple configs match, the most specific one wins

helpTip3.message: Short badge shows in the toolbar icon corner (max 4 chars)

helpTip4.message: Smart color inverts automatically against page background

agentPromptHint.message: Copies a prompt + current config to clipboard. Paste into ChatGPT / Claude / Codex, describe your setup, get JSON back.

toastPromptCopied.message: Prompt copied. Paste it into your AI assistant.

toastPromptCopyFailed.message: Failed to copy prompt. Check clipboard permission.

toastClipboardInvalid.message: Clipboard content is not a valid watermark config JSON.

toastClipboardReadFailed.message: Cannot read clipboard. Grant permission and try again.

helpAiPromptDesc.message: Click "Let AI write rules" to copy a prompt to clipboard, paste into ChatGPT / Claude / Codex, describe your scenario, and paste the JSON reply back via "Paste from clipboard".

helpFeedbackDesc.message: Found a bug or have suggestions? Open an issue on GitHub.
